title: SourceRef
description: Capture Truth 0.5-compatible structured provenance reference from a claim to a source record. source_id and locator are required. References carry locators and bounded metadata only, never verbatim source text; SourceRef has no text property. Plain string references and sourceId are deprecated; normalizers convert them to this shape, emit a deprecation finding, and flag the missing locator. Runtime privacy validation rejects credentials in HTTP(S) locator/url userinfo, query, and fragment components.

source_id.description: Identifier of a source record that exists in the same artifact.

locator.description: Concrete pointer to the evidence (URL, path, key, or stable id) captured at extraction time. Shape is validated here; runtime privacy validation rejects credentials in HTTP(S) locator userinfo, query, or fragment components. Missing on reviewed/extracted claims is at least needs_review.

note.description: Optional human note about what the source supports.

path.description: Optional file path captured at extraction time.

url.description: Optional absolute HTTP(S) URL captured at extraction time. Shape is validated here; runtime privacy validation rejects credential-like userinfo, query, or fragment components.

observed_at.description: When the evidence was observed, as a full RFC3339 datetime with Z or UTC offset.

source_updated_at.description: Last-modified time reported by the source system, as a full RFC3339 datetime with Z or UTC offset.

revision.description: Optional revision of the source at extraction time.

content_hash.description: Optional sha256 content hash in canonical 64-hex form, with or without a sha256: prefix.

heading.description: Timeline Truth provenance: section heading inside the source that contains the evidence.

tableRow.description: Timeline Truth provenance: 1-based row of the table inside the source that contains the evidence.

line.description: Timeline Truth provenance: 1-based line number inside the source that contains the evidence.
